2A.name: door-replay
inputs: Search Brandon's hideout for documents or equipment that could help us pose as outside inspectors and enter the main facility.
Examine the Continuity files for inspector credentials, facility access procedures, and cooling-water or ventilation records.
Go to the facility checkpoint and show the inspector credentials.
Tell the supervisor this is an unscheduled emergency inspection prompted by the facility's cooling-water and ventilation anomalies.
Enter the facility and follow the supervisor into the service corridors.
Follow the supervisor deeper into the service corridors and look for a way to reach the detention area.
Look for a concealed route or access panel leading from the service corridors to the detention area.
